services.name: Bike Rentals
services.desc: If you are planning on a trip to Kingston I invite you to take one of my guided bicycle tours of the city. We offer 1, 2 or 3 hour tours. You will see and learn about many things of natural and cultural interest, including campuses, parks, the lakeshore trail, harbours, prisons and other significant landmarks. The route is pretty flat and the pace leisurely and I can promise you an enjoyable and memorable experience. Follow the link to book a tour and please try to give at least 12 hours notice. services.name: SUP Rentals
services.desc: 10' 8" Inukshuk Stand Up Paddleboards by ClearWater Design. They are broad and stable, perfect for any level of paddlers, but particularly suited for beginners or rough water. We assist all customers to get your board ready and help launch and get out upon your return. We will provide you with some helpful suggestions for paddling destinations along Kingston's historic waterfront. All safety equipment included with rentals. Length: 10' 8" Width: 35" Weight: 45 Lbs. Capacity: 250 Lbs. Number in fleet: 18 Visit Weather and Wind Conditions to learn about how we determine weather

services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Our waterfront rental shop located in Kingston, Ontario is a 10 minute walk from downtown Kingston. We have everything you need to make your rental an easy and enjoyable experience. If you book ahead, we will have your boat rigged in advance. We have parking at our location, change rooms, public washrooms and a location where you can leave your valuables. If you want to take your phone on the water, we recommend renting one of our waterproof phone cases, just ask our staff. It is a good idea to check wind conditions before heading out, visit Weather and Wind Conditions to learn more. Finally, note that we do not send sailboats out if the wind speed is higher than 15 knots. Connect with us

services.name: Tandem Bikes
services.desc: This slick looking tandem bike will get everyone looking sideways at you as you coast down the path. Explore the waterfront path in Kingston or take the free ferry ride over to Wolfe Island and explore the secluded beach. We provide maps for both routes. Baskets, locks and helmets included. Hourly Rentals: Minimum one hour rental, additional hours rounded to the nearest 15 minute interval. Please note that your rental will be held for up to a maximum of 15 mins past your scheduled start time, after which it will be redistributed to customers as demand permits.
